Ez.bar_b_note: The saturated cyan-and-coral finned dragon has a Palworld-class silhouette and stands well over the ruler; it is held back by the A hit react rearing off the stage, the near-static B hit react and a 'ridden' frame with no visible rider.

Fk.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped recipe text, gold ingredients and icon-led Craft/Leave hints get close, but oversized list rows show only three recipes, the selection uses a pale border rather than teal, and the hints use keyboard glyphs, while A's tiny truncated rows and faint 'Craft: A / Enter' sink it.

Bs.bar_b_note: The naturalistic winged lion has a good silhouette and scale, but on both sides the faint frames read as a crouch rather than a collapse, A's hit react leaps clear of the stage, and the creature is tiny in the frame.

Gt.bar_b_note: The finned blue lizard is colourful and readable, but it is barely taller than the 1.80 m trainer; A's hit react matches its standing pose and its faint end collapses into a twisted ball, and in B the hit react also matches standing while both faint frames float with a clear gap above their shadows.

Ds.bar_b_note: The gold spider reads, but the player's creature is near-invisible on dark brown dirt, there is no purple storm sky or lightning grade, the telegraphs are flat magenta rings and chevrons (A i06-i10, i15-i17, tell2 a-b; B i10, i16-i17), the HUD eats the left and bottom of every frame, and in B (i12-i16) the camera sits inside green canopy.

Uw.bar_b_note: The white-haired elder with his moss-green vest and scarf has a clean, appealing face, readable eyes and a cozy palette that fits the key art's villagers, at a shipping-character finish, though he is more cartoon than the naturalistic creature bar.

Tn.bar_b_note: The mossy naturalistic turtle is well made, but its shell top only reaches about the trainer's height and it lacks rim light against the stage; A's faint mid balances the shell on its edge, and B's faint frames are an upright slump that does not read as fainted without the label.

Fb.bar_b_note: The coiled cyan sea serpent with magenta-pink fins has a strong, Palworld-class silhouette and grounded faint frames; the flat untextured water plane in the swimming frame and the rider standing beside it rather than mounted keep it short of full finish.

top_changes.change: Ds Stormwood fight: replace the flat magenta telegraph rings and chevrons with real-object tells (white-violet lightning, cracking stone) that end in an impact; add the purple storm sky and rim light so both fighters separate from the dark dirt; keep the fight camera out of the canopy (B i12-i16); shrink the left HUD stack

Creature hurt/faint pass: keep hit reacts on the ground but clearly different from standing (Ez A, Bs A, Gt both); make faint end a grounded roll onto the side or back, snapped to the stage with shadow contact (Bs crouch, Gt B float, Tn A on-edge, Tn B upright slump); show the rider mounted in travel frames (Ez ridden, Fb swimming)
Scale and craft UI: scale Tn and Gt so they clearly out-stand the 1.80 m trainer; adopt Fk B's type size but with compact recipe rows, a teal selection and controller glyphs for Craft/Leave
